identitySignals: Name matches a registered California LLC, 'Harvest Consulting LLC', located in Oakland, CA (bizprofile.net listing of California Secretary of State filing, entity number shown), matching the agenda's Oakland, CA

Registry lists Rachelle Lanette Rogers-ard as manager and the business purpose as coaching and professional learning; OUSD's 2020-2021 agreements were with Rachelle Rogers-Ard, and later ones with Harvest Consulting, which her website describes as her consulting firm

OUSD's own legislative record (File 23-0370) lists a Services Agreement with Harvest Consulting, Oakland, CA, for professional development for Adult Education Department staff, matching OUSD's classroom and academic programs contracts
Firm's page describes partnering with K-12 schools on leadership development and educator pipeline expansion, consistent with OUSD's education-related contracts
research.notes: Small consulting LLC whose principal is an individual; it is a registered business entity, so not treated as an individual vendor. Registry details come from a third-party mirror of the California Secretary of State record (bizprofile.net), not bizfile directly. Business address on the registry looks like it may be a personal or home address, so it was deliberately left out. No public phone or general email was found on the firm's page.

profile.summary: Harvest Consulting is an Oakland-based consulting firm founded in 2019. It works with K-12 schools, educational institutions, community organizations and businesses on leadership development, executive coaching, strategy and implementation management, and educator pipeline expansion.

sources.title: Harvest Consulting LLC Oakland, CA - filing information

review.notes: The CA registry mirror shows Harvest Consulting LLC in Oakland, managed by Rachelle Rogers-Ard, who is also the named counterparty in OUSD's 2020-21 agreements. OUSD's Legistar file 23-0370 lists a Harvest Consulting agreement (Oakland, CA) for Adult Education staff professional development. The firm's page supports the neutral summary, the 2019 founding date and the website; the entity number and headquarters are supported by the registry and Legistar.
